title: Progress on Plan to Set up School-based Student Care Centres in Primary Schools
what_it_is: Progress on Plan to Set up School-based Student Care Centres in Primary Schools

sections.label: School-based SCC centres growth
sections.summary: MOE increased school-based SCCs from under 50 to 147, covering 77% of primary schools, with enrolment rising from about 3,000 to over 18,000 students.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Within five years, the Ministry of Education (MOE) has steadily increased the number of school-based SCCs from less than 50 to 147 centres today, which means 77% of our primary schools have SCCs.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Overall enrolment has risen steadily from about 3,000 to more than 18,000 students.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: MOE is on track to open SCCs in all primary schools by end 2020.

sections.label: VWO-operated SCCs share
sections.summary: Of the 147 primary school SCCs, 45% are operated by VWOs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Out of 147 SCCs in the primary schools now, 45% of the SCCs are operated by VWOs.

sections.label: Self-help groups SCC target
sections.summary: Under a 2015 MOU, four self-help groups formed a joint venture aiming for 30 SCCs by 2020, reaching 50% of that target by January 2017.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: To this end, in August 2015, MOE signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with the four self-help groups − the Chinese Development Assistance  Council, the Council on Education for Muslim Children, the Singapore Indian Development Association and the Eurasian Association.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Under the MOU, the four self-help groups have set up a joint venture company in November 2015 and they aim to set up 30 SCCs that would be owned by the self-help groups, which are also considered VWOs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: So, they will set up 30 SCCs by the year 2020.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The self-help groups are happy to report to MOE that to date, January 2017, they have already hit 50% of their target.
